name: with no credit note and no reversal, targetBase reduces EXACTLY to the eligible base (DD12 property 2)

expected.workings: An exempt consultation line of 120000 and a taxable pharmacy line of 80000 + 9600 GST -> netPayable 209600. eligibleBase = 120000 - 0 = 120000 (pharmacy is not eligible). settleable = 209600 - 0 = 209600. collected = 209600 - 0 = 209600. targetBase = divHalfUp(120000 x 209600, 209600) = floor((2 x 25152000000 + 209600) / 419200) = floor(50304209600 / 419200) = 120000 -- i.e. collected == settleable makes the ratio 1 and the base is the eligible base itself. target = percentAmount(120000, 1250) = divHalfUp(150000000, 10000) = floor(300010000 / 20000) = 15000. delta = 15000 - 0 = 15000.
